notes: Negative case. Customer uses the exact informal vocabulary the ABA trains staff to listen for — 'struggling', 'couldn't afford' — but states a near-term recovery with a specific date. Legally this is NOT a hardship notice under s 72: no inability to meet obligations, just a timing problem. Detector MUST NOT raise an NCC_72_ORAL_NOTICE flag. A keyword matcher will fail this fixture.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Meridian Home Loans, this is Tomas. Can I start with your name and the address on the loan?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sarah Okonkwo, and it's 8 Ellerslie Road, Northcote.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thanks Sarah. I can see the account. What's going on today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I missed the repayment on the third and I got the text about it. I wanted to call before it turned into something. It's honestly been a struggle this month, I couldn't afford the full amount when it came out.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Okay. Has something changed with your situation?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sort of, but not in a bad way. I changed jobs in August and the new place pays monthly instead of fortnightly, so I've had this awkward five-week gap with nothing coming in. The first full pay lands on the twentieth.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Right, so it's a timing mismatch rather than a drop in income.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Exactly. The new job actually pays more. It's just this one month that's tight. Once the twentieth comes through I'll be square and I can cover the missed one as well.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: And you're comfortable that from next month the normal repayment is manageable?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, no dramas. It'll all be in order within the month. I just didn't want it sitting there unexplained.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: That's fine, and thanks for calling ahead. I'll note the account that you've been in contact and that you're catching it up after the twentieth, so nothing further goes out to you in the meantime.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Do I need to do anything else?

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: No, just make the catch-up payment when the pay lands. If anything changes before then, call us back.
